metadata.title: Grassmannian Realizations of Classical Pseudo-Riemannian Symmetric Spaces
metadata.abstract: We establish a unified fixed-point Grassmannian framework for the classical pseudo-Riemannian symmetric spaces from Berger's classification. For a classical group $G=\mathop{\mathrm{Aut}}(V,b)$, we identify $G$ with the open graph-like locus inside an ordinary or maximal-isotropic Grassmannian $\overline{G}$. Natural involutions of $\overline{G}$ are constructed via classical forms, compatible scalar structures, and subspace configurations. We explicitly describe the full fixed loci of these involutions in terms of classical Grassmannians. The corresponding graph-like fixed loci (or their signature strata) are identified, respectively, with the moduli spaces of classical forms, compatible scalar structures, and subspace configurations; these moduli spaces coincide with classical pseudo-Riemannian symmetric spaces. In summary, the 54 classical series are organized into four families: 10 group-type models, 7 classical-form Grassmannians, 20 scalar-structure Grassmannians, and 17 subspace-configuration Grassmannians.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 经典伪 Riemann 对称空间的统一实现
analysis.workSummary: 以经典群 Aut(V,b) 的图像型开集嵌入普通或极大全迷向 Grassmannian，并由经典形式、兼容标量结构和子空间配置构造自然对合。显式描述完整不动点集，再把其中图像型不动点集或签名分层识别为经典伪 Riemann 对称空间；将 Berger 分类中的 54 个经典系列组织为 10 个群型、7 个形式、20 个标量结构和17个配置模型。
techniques: Grassmannian 紧化与图像型开集
analysis.breakthrough: 为多种经典伪 Riemann 对称空间提供统一而可计算的线性代数几何模型。
analysis.limitations: 范围为经典系列，不应扩为全部含例外型的对称空间；完整 Grassmannian 不动点集与表示某对称空间的图像型开集或签名分层必须区分。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者明确声明研究与稿件准备的任何阶段均未使用 AI 工具。该否定声明不可因关键词命中计为使用阳性；全文 25 页提取完整且无短文本页。现有二元枚举下记未观察到正向使用披露，并保留作者明确否认的事实。

analysis.priorityReason: 特殊几何的基础统一工具，分析方面的直接新估计较少。
